# API Requirements Quality Checklist: Backend Version/Build Info Endpoint

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review ("unit tests for English") for the US-08 version/build-info endpoint, focused on API contract completeness/clarity and the read-only / non-functional boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-11-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete. Unchecked items are NOT a blocker for `/speckit.implement`.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the response fields enumerated completely and exhaustively, with none left implicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the source of each reported value (application version, read-contract version, source revision) documented in the requirements rather than only in research notes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the requirements for the unauthenticated-in-this-turn decision captured with their scope boundary (what is deferred vs. in scope)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the spec state the required HTTP interface documentation outcome (endpoint appears in the published interface) independent of a specific tool? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements present for the error-response contract (generic body + correlation identifier) as a first-class part of the endpoint's contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "fixed, documented shape" quantified as an exact, closed set of fields (no extras) so it is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the format/shape of the `app_version` value specified (e.g., SemVer-shaped, non-empty) rather than left open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the literal value and meaning of `read_contract_version` (`1.0.0`) stated unambiguously, including that it only mirrors an existing version? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "single source of truth captured at build/packaging time" defined clearly enough to distinguish it from an inline literal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the meaning of the `unknown` sentinel precisely defined (emitted string, not null or omitted key)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the acceptance scenarios, functional requirements, and the OpenAPI contract fragment agree on exactly three fields and their names? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the `read_contract_version` value `1.0.0` stated consistently across spec, data-model, and the contract fragment? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the read-only guarantees (no DB, no cache, no stored-table read, no writes) stated consistently wherever the endpoint behavior is described? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the requirements and assumptions agree that the existing error handler is reused unchanged (no new or divergent error shape)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Assumption]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Is the "under 30 seconds, single request, no container access" success criterion objectively measurable as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Can "0 database or cache interactions" be objectively verified from the requirement as stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "100% of successful responses include all three fields and no additional fields" expressed as a checkable criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the error-response criterion (0 responses expose stack trace/path/internals; every error carries a correlation identifier) measurable without inspecting implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for the no-source-revision build path (reports `unknown`, still succeeds)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the value-source-missing-or-empty case beyond source revision (safe-default fallback vs. request failure)? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for determinism (repeated requests to the same running build report identical values)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the unhandled-error path at the endpoint, distinct from the success path? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the behavior with the data store unavailable addressed in requirements (request still succeeds because it reads no store)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are the non-functional boundaries stated (off the real-time critical path, no synchronous GenAI/third-party calls) so reviewers can confirm Principle III alignment? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the security requirements that are deferred this turn (RBAC/JWT) explicitly scoped out rather than silently omitted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the no-information-disclosure non-functional requirement (no stack trace, path, or internal structure) stated as a requirement, not only an example? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption that the existing generic error handler already meets the error-shape requirement documented and validated? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that no new external dependency is introduced stated and consistent with the plan? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the dependency on an existing read-contract version (`corridor_now` / `source_status` at `1.0.0`) documented so drift can be detected? [Dependency, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption about where the source revision originates (build/packaging-time value, `unknown` when absent) captured in the requirements, not only in research? [Assumption, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK031 Is there any ambiguity about whether `read_contract_version` could ever differ from `1.0.0` this turn, and is the fixed-for-turn constraint explicit? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the boundary between "reports an existing contract version" and "defines/alters a contract" unambiguous, so no contract change is implied? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK033 Is there any conflict between the stated versioning/routing expectation and the requirement text (requirements describe outcome, not a specific path)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the stop-and-request-an-ADR condition (if delivery appears to require a `contracts/` change) stated as an unambiguous trigger? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state but must not modify markers; unchecked items here do not block implementation.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
